metrics.name: Permissive Any-to-Any Allow Firewall Rule Count
Geo-IP Block All Inbound Connections Enabled
WAN Allow Rules Permitting Management Traffic Count
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Firewall.AccessRulesIPv4[?From=='WAN' && Action=='allow' && ((ServiceName != null && contains(ServiceName, 'Management')) || ServiceAny==True)] | length(@)

metrics.name: Explicit Allow Any WAN-to-LAN Rules
metrics.jmesPathQuery: [Firewall.AccessRulesIPv4[?From == `WAN` && To == `LAN` && Action == `allow` && SourceAddressAny && DestinationAddressAny && Enable], Firewall.AccessRulesIPv6[?From == `WAN` && To == `LAN` && Action == `allow` && SourceAddressAny && DestinationAddressAny && Enable]][].Name

metrics.name: Zones Without Intrusion Prevention Count
metrics.gotcha: IntrusionPrevention is boolean False (not string 'false') — the Global metric uses backtick `false` which is JSON false in JMESPath. The id=106916 variant uses `Network.Zones[?IntrusionPrevention==False]` (Python-style) and also returns a valid result. Use backtick-quoted boolean for strict JMESPath compliance.
